name: Szigetújfalu (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of green and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Szigetújfalu (a blue and green shield with flowers, a star, a crown and a bunch of grapes) above a yellow scroll inscribed SZIGETÚJFALU.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
